name: Akogare no Okaa-san
source:
Jun lives with his mother, Kumiko. The older he gets, the more he sees her as a woman.... One day, Hitomi, Kumiko's younger sister and Jun's classroom teacher, starts living at their house. Jun actually loves her.... His love to them gradually gets bigger and....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Jun和他的母亲久美子住在一起。随着年龄的增长，他越来越将她视为女性……有一天，久美子的妹妹、纯的班主任瞳开始住在他们家。Jun其实是爱她的……他对他们的爱渐渐变大……

[来自工口游戏商店]
